agency: Idaho Department of Lands, Oil and Gas Conservation Commission
cadence: irregular (a permit is posted within days of its approval)
name: Idaho
note: Idaho approves very few: 8 permits to drill from January 2019 to September 2026, the newest on May 22, 2026, so a month with none is a real zero. Permits to drill, by the day the Commission approved each one: the date at the start of the Permit to Drill file linked from each well's page on its Well and Facilities Files list, checked against the signed permits and the Commission's quarterly counts. Two permits whose posted file is an amended version are counted at their first approval. Amendments, well treatments, seismic and injection permits are not available as dated records, and a permit that expired before a well was drilled has no page. Pages are posted within days to two weeks of approval, so the last 30 days are not shown. The list page was last edited June 4, 2026.
operators: SNAKE RIVER OIL AND GAS LLC
